notes.title: Another demo version released
notes.content: [p]I've released another version of the demo - 0.29.3 This one contains two major features as planned and a number of fixes. [/p][p][/p][p]Here are the features:[/p][list][*][p]Pickpocketing[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Improved stealth and stealth detection UI[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]These are the last planned features that I'm going to include in the demo. From now on I'll work on the full game - mostly world building, writing dialog and lore, level design and NPC/boss encounter design. I also need to work on adding new player weapons, cybernetics and equipment.[/p][p][/p][p]The major systems in the game are complete and tested, but they'll likely evolve as development continues and will need fixes and support. [/p][p][/p][p]But all in all things are going well! Cheers, folks - I hope you have a lovely weekend![/p][p][/p][p]Svet[/p]

notes.title: New Demo version released
notes.content: [p]I've released a new build of the demo (0.26.0-demo). It contains various fixes and features. One notable new features is the lock picking support - go ahead and give it a try![/p][p][/p][p]I've toned down the difficulty a bit and added some more enemies in the world. I'm looking forward for any feedback from players in the Steam Community forums or in the discord. [/p][p][/p][p]I'm planning to add two more features to the demo by the end of July:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Stealing/pickpocketing support.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved stealth detection with a visibility indicator, detection delay and animation.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]After those two are added the plan is to continue development and design of the main game. [/p][p][/p][p]Cheers and have a great week, folks![/p]

notes.title: Demo released!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274025/d8037fade7920558f1f0dffdc680d95ba4d6c655.png"][/img][/p][p]I'm excited to announce that after a successful closed playtest, the [b]Enhanced: Vengeance Demo[/b] is now [b]publicly released[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]The demo features the entire first chapter of the full game. The quests, stats, skills, character creation, and other core features are included in the demo and may continue to evolve during development. If you enjoy the demo, you're welcome to join the [url="https://discord.gg/zBUjUjdMNY"]Discord community[/url], where I'm actively involved. I'm always listening to feedback about bugs, features and anything else you're like to discuss - game-related or not.[/p][p][/p][p]Don't forget to [b]wishlist and follow[/b] if you enjoy the demo! It makes a [b]HUGE[/b] difference to me and to the future of the game![/p][p][/p][p]Cheers, and I hope you enjoy the demo![/p][p][/p][p]Svet[/p]
